recipes.name: Sanji's Seafood Risotto
ingredients: 6 oz squid tubes, cut into rings
48 oz fish stock or homemade seafood stock
instructions: For the Seafood & Seafood Stock
Peel and devein shrimp, using a paper towel for extra grip to remove the digestive tract. Reserve the shells. - 8 oz shrimp peeled & deveined
Slice squid tubes into rings. - 6 oz squid tubes cut into rings
Separate the legs from octopus for easier cooking. - 3 lb octopus
In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. - 3 tbsp olive oil
Add shrimp shells and any lobster shells, toasting them until they turn bright orange, about 2 to 3 minutes. - 8 oz shrimp peeled & deveined - 1 ½ lobster shells
Add the octopus legs and head, cooking for another 2 minutes. - 3 lb octopus

Pour in water, then add chopped onions, parsley stems, carrots, celery, bay leaves, and peppercorns. - water to cover - 1 yellow onion finely chopped - 2 carrots roughly chopped - 3 celery stalks roughly chopped - 7 parsley stems roughly chopped - 2 bay leaves - 2 tsp black peppercorns
Bring to a simmer and let cook for 1 hour to develop flavors and tenderize the octopus.
Strain the stock through a fine mesh sieve, reserving the octopus legs for later. - 3 lb octopus
For the Risotto
In a high-walled saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat. - 3 tbsp olive oil
Add finely chopped yellow onion and shallot with a pinch of salt, cooking until translucent, about 3-4 minutes. - ½ yellow onion chopped - 1 shallot finely chopped - pinch of salt
Add Arborio rice, toasting until the grains turn translucent, about 2-3 minutes. - 7 oz Arborio rice
Pour in dry white wine, stirring until absorbed. - 120 ml dry white wine
For the Assembly
Begin adding the seafood stock to the rice, 1/4 cup at a time, stirring constantly until absorbed before adding more. - For the Seafood & Seafood Stock - For the Risotto
Continue this process until most of the stock is absorbed, leaving about 1/4 cup for the final step. - For the Seafood & Seafood Stock - For the Risotto
Once most of the stock has been incorporated, add the shrimp, squid, and reserved octopus legs to the risotto. - 8 oz shrimp peeled & deveined - 6 oz squid tubes cut into rings - 3 lb octopus

Stir in the remaining stock and cook until the shrimp turn bright orange and the squid firms into rings, about 2-3 minutes. - For the Seafood & Seafood Stock - 48 oz fish stock or homemade seafood stock
Turn off the heat, then stir in butter and finely chopped parsley. - 1 ½ oz cold butter - 2 tbsp fresh parsley finely chopped
Optional: Fold in two generous handfuls of grated Parmesan cheese for a richer texture and flavor. - 2 handfuls parmesan cheese optional
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. - salt to taste
Serve hot, garnished with extra parsley if desired. - 2 tbsp fresh parsley finely chopped
